# Components

14 reusable composite elements. Each one expands into ordinary text, shape or media layers that stay editable afterward, and every created layer is labelled `component:<id>`.

```ts
addComponent(project, { component: "lower-third", start: 2, duration: 4, params: { name: "Ada", title: "Engineer" } });
```

With Claude, use the `add_component` tool. Templates use components in their scenes. Register your own with `registerComponent`.

## lower-third

**Lower Third** (text, default 4s). Name + title bar in the lower-left area. Introduce a speaker, guest or location.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | Primary line, e.g. a person's name |
| `title` | string |  | `""` | Secondary line, e.g. role or company |
| `accentColor` | string |  | `"#6C47FF"` |  |
| `textColor` | string |  | `"#FFFFFF"` |  |
| `fontFamily` | string |  | `"Arial"` |  |

## title-card

**Title Card** (structure, default 3s). Large centered title with an optional subtitle. Openers, section headers, end cards.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes |  |  |
| `subtitle` | string |  | `""` |  |

| `y` | number |  | `0.45` |  |

## hook-text

**Hook Text** (social, default 3s). Big punchy statement at the top of the frame for the first seconds of a short. Stops the scroll.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  |  |
| `color` | string |  | `"#FFFFFF"` |  |
| `highlight` | string |  | `"#FFE600"` | Background box color |
| `textOnHighlight` | string |  | `"#000000"` |  |
| `boxed` | boolean |  | `true` |  |
| `y` | number |  | `0.2` |  |
